description:
Eonevus_time:时间在喧哗，可是他们都已经死去，曾经为同一个理想而奋斗的人皆死于围剿，皆放弃于劝诱。我们已经犯下了那么多的罪恶，可是却仍旧看不到希望。或许巫王的时代再不可能重来，即便所有人都对连绵不断的战争与苦难感到厌恶，巫王时代也无法重来了……命运啊命运，我所做的一切是否还有意义，我们所行之事是否还有价值？

Time is Shouting, but they have all died, and those who once fought for the same ideal have died in encircling and suppression, and have given up on persuasion. We have committed so many crimes, but there is still no hope. Perhaps the time of the Witch King will never come again, even if everyone is sick of the constant war and suffering, the time of the Witch King will never come again... Fate, fate, does what I do still matter, does what we do still matter?

-
